mechanics.claim: Shunpo deals magic damage to the nearest enemy in range and applies on-hit effects.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the nearest enemy and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects.

mechanics.claim: Shunpo resets Katarina's basic attack timer, unless it killed the target.
mechanics.quote: Shunpo {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Katarina's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Shunpo will still deal damage but not apply on-hit effects if dodged, and cannot be blocked or missed while Katarina is blinded.
mechanics.quote: ''Shunpo'' will still deal damage but not apply on-hit effects if {{tip|dodged}}. It cannot be {{tip|block|blocked}} nor can it be missed while '''Katarina''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
